rule dac_win_0113 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "WmiPrvSE / wsmprovhost unusual children - Sysmon 1 Parent WmiPrvSE/wsmprovhost to cmd/powershell/LOLBins"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0113"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1047"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1021.006"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    ($e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\WmiPrvSE\.exe$/ nocase or $e.principal.process.command_line = /\\WmiPrvSE\.exe$/ nocase or $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\wsmprovhost\.exe$/ nocase or $e.principal.process.command_line = /\\wsmprovhost\.exe$/ nocase or $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\winrshost\.exe$/ nocase or $e.principal.process.command_line = /\\winrshost\.exe$/ nocase)
    ($e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\cmd\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\\cmd\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\powershell\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\\powershell\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\pwsh\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\\pwsh\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\certutil\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\\certutil\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\mshta\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\\mshta\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\rundll32\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\\rundll32\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\bitsadmin\.exe$/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /\\bitsadmin\.exe$/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
